gve_product_semantics_noted_for_separati: specs/ levels 0-3 contain GVE-specific product semantics (governed execution, workflows, operations, plugins, effects, evidence, results). These belong to the future GVE product, not the reusable framework template.

src/gve/ contains the GVE product CLI. It belongs to the future GVE product.
